works.body:
Hello! I am submitting this request as a gift for Viri Morelia.
Viri is an artist and a streamer until she had to end streaming activities last year due to university. She has come back this year and is planning to stream again with an updated design and model. If possible, I'd appreciate something with a vibe like "welcome back" or "It's good to see you again".  I hope you accept my request and look forward to what you come up with. Thank you!

https://twitter.com/555_viri/status/1680772650715545600

Hello Riyu!
Thank-you for reaching out to me!
I would be more than happy for you to draw my character!

Please use: *AMEDOLL REFERENCE Kaptivate*, *AMEDOLL REFERENCE ComfyPai* and *AMEDOLL REFERENCE SHEET - GINKO V6* as reference for the yellow design.

I do not have any specific position I want my VTuber character drawn in, but please have fun with the design!
I cannot wait to see what you draw, I am very excited.

Thank-you!
- AmeDoll

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15U4Lys7oPzoGIUiEfn2qUTOmZT2-X4i0?usp=sharing

Hello!  Thank you for reaching out to me.  I would love to see myself in your art style!

I would like to request a picture of my VTuber, Reisa Forte.  She is a virtual idol.  She loves to sing, but she has a very loud personality and can be boyish at times.  She is very confident, but she also cares deeply about her fans.

Notes:
- Green eyes
- Thick, black eyebrows
- Black eyelashes

I have included a reference.

I would like to use the art on social media.  Please include a version with a transparent background. Thank you!

Hello Riyu@illustrator Live2D-san! absolutely love your art style! If possible I would like to request an illustration of my VTuber Chiharu. 

She is a snow leopard that lives in the clouds alongside her baby snow leopard. She is elegant but is slightly sexy. Her dress is based off a qipao. If possible, I would like the baby snow leopard to be included.

With your permission, I would like to use it for twitter, twitch and youtube. If possible, I would like the background and signature to be separated from the character illustration. 

For the pose, may I have Chiharu holding her fan? I leave the expression up to you!! ^^

Thank you for your time and consideration! ^^

Hi! I love your artwork! It's so cool and cute at the same time! I was wondering if you could draw my vtuber model. If possible, I would like to use the artwork on my SNS and on Twitch. 

 Wushii is my character and she is a tsundere cat girl. She is 172cm and gets shy and flustered easily. She annoys people for fun and enjoys playing video games, especially FPS games. 
The pose, expression, outfit and background are completely up to you. I would like her to be dressed like a gangster. 

Could I have one picture of her with her mouth like she's talking and another closed? 

Thank you so much!

https://i.imgur.com/6hnPUqH.jpg

I should be a bit taller than her but not by too much. I would also like to be able to turn this into a poster or TShirt I could sell as merch. If this is okay for the price, please let me know!

I also am including extra for rush fee.

Hello, I recently found your artwork of Vshojo. I love how you draw eyes and expressions! Can you please draw my character?

My character is a delinquent and a leader of a biker gang that rules the streets at night. She can be silly sometimes but she will have a tough and mischievous attitude when she is provoked by other people. She will fight anyone who gets in her way and beat them until she is satisfied.

Can you please give her a mischievous expression while she is holding a cigarette on her hand? The pose is up to you. 

I will be using this for my twitch channel and SNS.

Thank you very much!
